0.2.0.description:
# THE TRAP RELEASE

- All Traps from Jak 1 and 2 are now in Jak 3!!!!!!!
- Wanna play as the Jak 2 model in-game? NOW YOU CAN! WARNING: Shadows are a bit broken and you won't see any armor on Jak that he gets.
- Seal of Mar and Gun Turret have been properly added


## What's next?
- Deathlink
- adding options for dual checks
- and MORE!!!!!

1.1.0.description:
## FEATURES

- Randomized options for skull gems cost for side missions
- 2 new traps! what are they? you'll just have to see :)


## BUG FIXES

- Fixed some missions having not the correct requirements 
- Fixed Chase Down Metal Heads mission being required to beat first
- Fixed Corral Leaper Lizards mission not working if you die during the mission
- Fixed Blow Barrier with Blast Bot Mission softlocking after reaching the barrier
- Fixed Random Ammo not working if you don't have the first weapon of each color.
- Fixed Destroy Precursor Ship not closing the resolution task
